levels.supported: Test a bounded mechanism using service and transaction traces
levels.not_supported: Population causal effect from isolated examples

levels.supported: Estimate a disclosed scenario with sensitivity
Estimate effect under explicit identification assumptions and diagnostics

levels.not_supported: Authority to experiment or proof beyond sampled context

selection_rule: Choose the strongest feasible authorized design that fits the service and evidence. This is not an automatic numeric causal-quality score.
baseline_controls: Already approved or embedded reforms included.
Freeze comparator selection before outcome inspection.
Maintain adverse observations, transferred work and residual liabilities.
State demand, security, mandate, timing and price confounders.
Credible continuing requirement and procurement path for avoidance.
missing_comparator_action: Narrow to descriptive or control finding; withhold monetary attribution.
